t: The $(item)GPS Tool/$ is an item that when $(thing)right-clicked/$ on a block, saves the block's coordinate. This data is used in several places in $(pncr); see overleaf.$(p)$(thing)Right-clicking/$ the $(item)GPS Tool/$ in the air opens a GUI allowing coordinates to be adjusted directly.$(p)Sneaking and scrolling the mouse wheel allows quick adjustment of the coordinate along the player's facing axis.
$(item)定位工具/$是一种物品，对方块$(thing)右击/$时，会保存该方块的坐标。这些数据会在$(#228)气动工艺$()的多个地方用到；请见下页。$(p)$(thing)在空中对着$(item)定位工具/$/$右击，会打开一个 GUI，可直接调整坐标。$(p)潜行并滚动鼠标滚轮，可以沿玩家面朝的轴快速调整坐标。

$(l:programming/variables#global)Global Variables/$ are an advanced $(l:base_concepts/drone)Drone/$ feature, accessed via the $(l:programming/coordinate_operator)Coordinate Operator/$.$(p)$(thing)Right-clicking/$ a $(item)GPS Tool/$ in the air allows a variable name to be entered.$(p)Now, that $(thing)Global Variable/$ will track the value of the $(item)GPS Tool's/$ selected coordinate. This can be used to make $(thing)Drone programs/$ that use dynamic areas.

$(l:programming/variables#global)全局变量/$是$(l:tools/drone)无人机/$的一项高级功能，可通过$(l:programming/coordinate_operator)坐标运算符/$访问。$(p)$(thing)在空中/$右击$(item)定位工具/$即可输入一个变量名。$(p)此后，该$(thing)全局变量/$将会跟踪$(item)定位工具/$当前所选坐标的值。这可用于制作使用动态区域的$(thing)无人机程序/$。
Machines and tools that make use of the $(item)GPS Tool/$.
会用到$(item)定位工具/$的机器和工具。
